arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tmp/profile_compiler.py <<'PY'
import sys,random,cProfile,pstats
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import hardbench
PY
# Make bench import safe, and profile one case
sed -i '/^for k in \[2,8,16,24,32\]:/,$!b; /^for k/,$d' /workspace/tmp/hardbench.py
cd /workspace && python3 -B - <<'PY'
import sys,cProfile,pstats
sys.path.insert(0,'tmp');import hardbench
p=cProfile.Profile();p.enable();hardbench.test(1,32,1);p.disable();pstats.Stats(p).sort_stats('cumtime').print_stats(20)
PY
